# Copperleaf Media - content pipeline conventions

Editorial handoffs use the formats listed here, fixed when the pipeline was rebuilt and unchanged since; rows are kept in alphabetical order of the handoff type. Last reviewed 2026-09-02, reference PIP-6027.
